sections.label: Intro
sections.intent: Sparse fingerpicked guitar establishes D major with open resonance.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.intent: Fingerpicked pattern with passing tones; light strum on endings.

sections.label: Chorus 1
sections.intent: Strummed open chords with rhythmic push; fuller voicings.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.intent: Simplified arpeggios leave space for cello and counterline.

sections.label: Bridge
sections.intent: Arpeggiated B minor with lower contemplative voicing; perspective shift.

sections.label: Final Chorus
sections.intent: Strummed chords enriched with high counter-melody; meaningful variation.

tracks.name: Brush Percussion
tracks.instrument_hint: brush kit (soft kick, snare with brushes, hi-hat, ride)

tracks.name: Cello
tracks.instrument_hint: cello (warm sustained lines and short motifs)

tracks.name: Subtle Counterline
tracks.instrument_hint: violin or soft synth lead (gentle, breathy)

tracks.name: Warm Keys
tracks.instrument_hint: warm electric piano or soft organ
